title: Enterprise Connectivity: billing calendar timezone
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following billing calendar timezone for each named contract tier. Timezone used for calendar boundaries; IANA timezone string.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | billing calendar timezone | UTC |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | billing calendar timezone | UTC |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | billing calendar timezone | UTC |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | billing calendar timezone | UTC |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | billing calendar timezone | UTC |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | billing calendar timezone | UTC |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the billing calendar timezone is UTC.
